Happy Birthday, Surekha!

Dear Ammulu,

You are so special to me, more than words can properly say. You have the prettiest smile — the kind that can make an ordinary day feel brighter. And your beautiful heart makes you even more wonderful.

I feel lucky to have you as my best friend. Thank you for all the laughter, little memories, and the comfort of having you in my life. I hope this year brings you the happiness you give to the people around you, dreams that come true, and countless reasons to smile.

Never forget how loved, valued, and truly one of a kind you are. Keep shining, Ammulu. The world is sweeter with you in it. 💗

Happy Birthday, my dear Ammulu! ✨
